cinematic_dialogue:2:1410317201:.text: By the Queen's grace, may these crude stones be—
cinematic_dialogue:2:1410317201:.source_cn: 女王在上，赐予这些粗糙的石材——

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410317202:.text: Always Queen this and Queen that...
cinematic_dialogue:2:1410317202:.source_cn: 又来了！整天把女王挂嘴边

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410317204:.text: Huh? Wait a second, is that...

say:6:1410319001:0.text: Aunt Zanie... is it really you?
say:6:1410319001:0.source_cn: 祖娅姑姑……真的是祖娅姑姑吗？

say:9:1410319003:1.text: Aunt Zanie! It's really you! Helthor's beard, I can't believe my eyes!
say:9:1410319003:1.source_cn: 姑姑！真是你！赫托在下……我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛！

say:10:1410319004:1.text: Uh. W-wrong person! Never seen you before in my life!

say:11:1410319005:1.text: Oh, come on! It's me! Finn! You know, the kid who stole your wine, and then you walloped me so hard I saw stars!
say:11:1410319005:1.source_cn: 怎么会？是我啊！芬恩！小时候我偷喝你的酒，还被你狠狠打...

say:12:1410319006:1.text: Helthor's hammer, <style="highlight">you haven't aged a day in a hundred years!</style>

say:13:1410319007:1.text: Where in the underground have you been all these years? No word, no message! Even Eldric wouldn't tell me anything!
say:13:1410319007:1.source_cn: 这么些年你去哪了？一点消息都没有！弗林什么都不肯说。

say:14:1410319008:1.text: Speaking of Eldric, he's chief now! After you left he—
say:14:1410319008:1.source_cn: 说起来，你走之后，弗林就当上了村长。要我说——

say:18:1410319009:1.text: Toplander! If you have time to chat, you have time to work! No slacking!
say:18:1410319009:1.source_cn: 地表人！你还有闲心聊天？快干活！不要偷懒！

say:19:1410319010:1.text: Hey! Who do you think you're talking to? I'm no servant of yours! Try showing some respect!
say:19:1410319010:1.source_cn: 嘿，你说谁呢？我可不是你们的仆从！放尊重点！

say:20:1410319011:1.text: Don't forget, it was you dwarves who came begging for echorites! Without Her Majesty's generosity, you'd be left with nothing!
say:20:1410319011:1.source_cn: 别忘了，是你们矮人喊着求着想要深岩晶！如果不是女王开恩...

say:21:1410319012:1.text: Without our magic, your so-called "craftsmanship" is just lifeless rock!
say:21:1410319012:1.source_cn: 没有我们的魔法，你们造的东西不过是堆死石头！

say:22:1410319013:1.text: Excuse me?! If it weren't for us dwarves, you Essail wouldn't even have a city to strut around in!
say:22:1410319013:1.source_cn: 哈？！要不是我们矮人，你们这群尖耳朵怕是连个遮风挡雨的...

say:23:1410319014:1.text: Look at these arches, these pillars. Every single one is the work of my ancestors!
say:23:1410319014:1.source_cn: 瞧瞧这些拱门和立柱，哪一块不是我们祖辈的心血？

say:24:1410319015:1.text: Watch your tongue! The fact that we allowed your kind to work on this sacred project is already an act of mercy!
say:24:1410319015:1.source_cn: 注意你的语气。让你们这些地表种族参与神圣工程，已是莫大...

say:25:1410319016:1.text: Oh please! So what? The temple is sacred, but somehow, your royal city isn't.
say:25:1410319016:1.source_cn: 得了吧！建神殿才是神圣工程，给你们修王城算什么神圣？

say:26:1410319017:1.text: What? Drinking a few drops of Divine Dew makes you gods now?
say:26:1410319017:1.source_cn: 怎么，喝几口灵露就把自己当神了？
say:26:1410319017:1.male: What? Drinking a few drops of Divine Dew makes you gods now?
say:26:1410319017:1.female: What? Drinking a few drops of Divine Dew makes you gods now?

say:27:1410319018:1.text: Enough! You'll hold your tongue and prepare the stones!

say:29:1410319019:1.text: Oh yeah? Make me! I'm on break!
say:29:1410319019:1.male: Oh yeah? Make me! I'm on break!
say:29:1410319019:1.female: Oh yeah? Make me! I'm on break!

say:31:1410319020:1.source_cn: 你！那你就永远地休息吧！

narration:36:14010399:0.text: Nearby, an Essail is offering a prayer over a stone and starts arguing with a dwarf. You happen to walk by, and the dwarf immediately recognizes Zanie.
narration:36:14010399:0.source_cn: 艾塞勒祭司对着石材祝祷时，与旁边的矮人吵了起来。你们恰...

narration:36:14010399:0.female: Nearby, an Essail is offering a prayer over a stone and starts arguing with a dwarf. You happen to walk by, and the dwarf immediately recognizes Zanie.
